title: Conformal Killing Gravity: New Constraints from DESI DR2 BAO datasets
summary: We investigate a geometric approach referred to as the Conformal Killing Gravity (CKG), in which the dark energy sector emerges naturally from the conformal Killing symmetry of the Robertson--Walker space-time. Within this framework, the divergence-free conformal Killing tensor behaves as an effective perfect fluid, giving rise to a dynamical dark-energy component whose density, pressure, and equation of state are uniquely determined by the underlying geometry, without introducing any empirical dark-energy parametrization.
